description: This file defines an abstract class `PrimaryBasedLogViewAdaptor` that provides a generic framework for constructing log view adaptors based on a primary, supporting read/write and notification handling, primarily used in a distributed log/consistency context within Orleans framework. It includes methods for submission, confirmation, synchronization, and notification processing, as well as background worker coordination.

classes.name: PrimaryBasedLogViewAdaptor
classes.description: An abstract generic class for log view adaptors that coordinate reading, writing, notifications, and state management around a primary in a distributed setting.

classes.name: SubmissionEntry
classes.description: Represents a log entry submission with metadata such as submission time, promise for success/failure, and conditional position.

methods.name: PreOnActivate
methods.description: Preparation step before activation, sets a flag for initial read.

methods.name: PostOnActivate
methods.description: Post-activation steps, starts worker if needed.

methods.name: PostOnDeactivate
methods.description: Cleanup after deactivation, waits for background worker to finish.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a single log entry for append.

methods.name: SubmitRange
methods.description: Submits a range of log entries.

methods.name: TryAppend
methods.description: Attempts appending a log entry asynchronously, returning success/failure.

methods.name: TryAppendRange
methods.description: Attempts appending multiple log entries asynchronously.

methods.name: OnProtocolMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol or notification messages.

methods.name: ConfirmSubmittedEntries
methods.description: Confirms the currently pending log entries.

methods.name: UnconfirmedSuffix
methods.description: Returns log entries that are pending confirmation.
